snippet.title: The Places Where Snow Lingers - Now Available on Itch.io
snippet.description:
https://warlockomen.itch.io/the-places-where-snow-lingers

A short walking simulator in N64 style. You and your companion come across an abandoned town and have a conversation on whether you should stay there or keep going.

There are 5 conversations to find before you leave.
